metadata.title: Clicked like I was chasing a fly and somehow caught that 1 unlucky soul? Valorant logic broke
metadata.description:
Clicked like I was swatting air and boom, 1 kill outta nowhere.
Enemy probably questioning reality or uninstalling.
Did NOT deserve that but hey, I’ll take the chaos.
If your aim’s a beautiful mess, this one’s for you.

Tap if your aim’s a glorious disaster too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
